parameters.name: GatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the private gateway. You can obtain the ID from the private\_gateway\_id field in the response of the ListResources operation.

parameters.name: GatewayName
parameters.description: The alias of the private gateway.

parameters.name: InternetEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable access over the public network.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the gateway list to return. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of gateways to return on each page. The default value is 100.

parameters.name: ResourceName
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. You can obtain the ID from the ResourceId field in the response of the [ListResources](~~412133~~) operation.
